_about: What each investigation burned, changed and measured, and what it says it is for on Earth: the attributes the challenge statement asks a dashboard to summarize. EXTRACTED BY AI (Claude, Anthropic) from the PSI record text and table headers in data/psi/raw/, then checked by program: scripts/build_dataset.py refuses to build unless every 'quote' is found word for word in the named field of that investigation's record, and every 'column' is a real column of one of its Experimental Tables. The short 'text' beside each quote is our plain wording. null means the record does not say.
